verdict.rationale: Mercury documents automations such as AI bookkeeping automations, automatic invoices and auto-funding rules, so this axis applies to it. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to version, review or roll back those automations. API path versioning, the public changelog and approval queues for payments are adjacent features about the API or individual transactions, not the user's automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
